title: alopecurus aequalis subsp. aristulatus
intro: Alopecurus aequalis subsp. aristulatus, commonly known as the false foxtail, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Alopecurus aequalis subsp. aristulatus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
